title: REQ · The worker Go module is deleted from backend/
summary: backend/worker and its go.mod no longer exist.
description: Context: backend/worker is a separate module (module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker) holding poller, config, recovery, runner, lock, provider, report, logging and store packages plus configs/config.example.yaml. Desired behavior: the whole directory is removed with its tests. Expected result: no worker files remain. Why: development automation must not live here.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when backend/worker is stat'ed, then it does not exist.
Given backend/go.mod, when read, then it does not reference the worker module.

in_scope: All files under backend/worker including tests
